name: Outlines
summary: Structured LLM output library from .txt (dottxt): JSON/schema/grammar constraints with broad model integrations.
description: Established Apache-2.0 structured-generation library (dottxt-ai/outlines; not archived). PyPI outlines 1.3.3 verified 2026-11-09. Docs at https://dottxt-ai.github.io/outlines/. Optional commercial/enterprise offerings from .txt are separate from the open-source package. Model inference costs are not included. Official docs disagree on LlamaCpp context-free grammar support, so this entry does not claim it either way: the models feature matrix marks LlamaCpp Grammar as unsupported (https://dottxt-ai.github.io/outlines/latest/features/models/); the LlamaCpp page says the model “supports all output types available in Outlines” and includes a Context-free grammar section (https://dottxt-ai.github.io/outlines/latest/features/models/llamacpp/); backends.md lists LlamaCpp as a steerable model that can use outlines_core or llguidance (not xgrammar) and shows Grammar supported by llguidance/xgrammar but not outlines_core (https://dottxt-ai.github.io/outlines/latest/features/advanced/backends/). Check those pages for the revision you are using.

agent_access.notes: Local Python package: pip install outlines. Enterprise products at docs.dottxt.co are separate.
